For now, a plurality of Alabama voters still approves of Trump’s job performance. But the latest numbers indicate a notable change since the beginning of August, when more than half of Alabama voters approved of the president.

Featured Weekly Ad [...] The latest figures show 48% of Alabama voters approve of Trump’s job performance, compared with 42% who disapprove. Another 10% neither approve nor disapprove.

That marks a five-point drop in approval since early August, when 53% of Alabama voters approved of Trump’s performance and 40% disapproved.

The latest numbers also show a slight increase in disapproval and in the share of voters who remain neutral.
